reasoning: REVA, Inc. is a well-documented fixed-wing air ambulance company headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, operating under Part 135 cert O2JA. The operator's own site (flyreva.com / revaair.com) explicitly uses the legal name 'REVA, Inc.' and describes a fleet of 15 dedicated aircraft operating domestically and internationally. However, revaair.com redirects to flyreva.com and both resolve to the same hostname/content, meaning both scraped URLs count as a single independent domain. All external sources attempted (AINonline, ITIJ, Wikipedia) returned 404 or no article. The two-source requirement (two distinct hostnames) cannot be satisfied within the 8-scrape cap, so the decision is returned as ambiguous rather than new_entity despite strong single-source evidence.

Air Ambulance Company of the Year 2025
--------------------------------------

ITIJ named REVA Air Ambulance Company of the Year in recognition of our ability to deliver life-saving care in the air, including advanced clinical missions such as transatlantic ECMO transfers for critically ill patients.

REVA'S STORY
============

Our clients are our first priority. We offer comfort. We offer compassion. We offer complete care.

REVA'S MISSION
--------------

To provide safe, efficient, compassionate, air-ambulance transportation across the country, or overseas, to every patient we take into our care.

30+ Years of Experience
-----------------------

Our air-ambulance team is comprised of experienced specialists who have completed over 30,000 flights in 90 countries. Our more than 350 employees are trained and educated to standards higher than the industry requires. We have been recognized numerous times by government and industry agencies for excellence in safety and service. With a fleet of 15 aircraft and strategically located bases, our reach is global. When it comes to our clients, our collaboration is personal. Our clients are our first priority. We **[offer comfort](https://www.flyreva.com/blog/the-importance-of-patient-comfort-in-medical-evacuations/)
**. We offer compassion. We offer complete care.

"Twenty-five years later, I am proud to be a part of REVA, who has positively impacted thousands of patient and families, across the globe, providing the highest quality and safest emergency and medical transportation."

#### Stuart Hayman

[Chief Executive Officer](https://www.flyreva.com/stuart-hayman/ "Chief Executive Officer")

Stuart is currently CEO for REVA, Inc., providing support and leadership to a global team with hubs  
in Fort Lauderdale, Puerto Rico, New York and Ireland.

additional_evidence_needed: A second independent hostname confirming REVA, Inc. as a Part 135 air ambulance operator. Suggested sources: (1) AINonline search for 'REVA air ambulance' at a valid URL (the constructed URLs 404'd); (2) ITIJ awards listing page at awards.itij.com (valid URL needed); (3) Florida Division of Corporations sunbiz.org entity search for 'REVA Inc' to confirm legal incorporation and aviation business purpose; (4) FAA CAROL query for cert O2JA to confirm holder name directly. The operator's own site (flyreva.com) unambiguously uses 'REVA, Inc.' as its legal name and describes a Fort Lauderdale-based Part 135 air ambulance fleet, but self-publication alone does not satisfy the two-source rule.
